en.b_hero_tagline: Car crash, auto accident and personal injury lawyers for Los Angeles drivers and passengers
en.b_hero_sub: Car wreck, truck, motorcycle, pedestrian, Uber/Lyft or hit and run: the insurance company is already working to pay you less. A Los Angeles car accident attorney at Robert Hindin & Associates takes those calls instead. Injured people only since 1975, never an insurance company. Free consultation. No fees unless we win.

b_sections.h: Auto accident and car wreck lawyers in Los Angeles
p: Whether you call it an auto accident, a car wreck, or a fender bender that turned out to be worse than it looked, the insurance playbook is the same. The adjuster calls fast, asks for a recorded statement, and puts a number on the table before anyone knows how badly you are hurt.

Our Los Angeles car accident lawyers take over the whole claim: preserving the evidence from the car wreck, getting you to a doctor, and negotiating with every insurer involved. If your auto accident happened on the 405, the 10, the 101 or a surface street, the clock that matters is measured in days, because that is how long most camera footage survives.

b_sections.h: Serving Beverly Hills, Woodland Hills, Long Beach and all of LA County
p: Our office is on Olympic Boulevard in West Los Angeles, a short drive from Beverly Hills and Century City. We represent people hurt in crashes across Los Angeles County, from Woodland Hills and the rest of the San Fernando Valley along the 101, to Long Beach and the 405 and 710 corridor to the south.
You do not need to come to the office to get started. The free case review happens by phone, at any hour, in English or Spanish.

en.b_cases_intro: Every crash is different. What they have in common is an adjuster deciding what your injury is worth before you have said a word. These are the Van Nuys cases we handle most, from red-light crashes on Van Nuys Boulevard to chain-reaction wrecks near the 405/101 interchange.
en.b_case_5_b: Three, four, five cars on the 405 or the 101, and every insurer blaming the car behind. These cases are won by identifying every policy and reconstructing the order of impacts early, before each carrier settles into its story.

b_sections.h: A car accident lawyer near you in Van Nuys
p: Searching for a car accident lawyer near you usually means you are hurt, your car is out of commission, and getting across town to an office is the last thing you can manage. You should not have to. Our office is in West Los Angeles, just over the Sepulveda Pass on the 405, but we come to you.
li: At home, in the hospital, or by video. We meet wherever is easiest while you recover.
Any hour, in English or Spanish. A real person answers around the clock. Leave your number and we call you back.
Next-day doctor appointment. We work to get you seen by a doctor the day after you call, with nothing to pay up front.
Ask about a rental car. If your car is in the shop or totaled, ask us about a rental while the property damage claim is sorted out.
